bug_semantics: `zarf package inspect sbom` and `zarf package inspect documentation` build the extraction destination as filepath.Join(userOutputDir, pkg.Metadata.Name) (documentation also suffixes `-documentation`). Metadata.Name is read from the untrusted package zarf.yaml; create-time regex `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9\-]*$` is not re-applied on inspect. A crafted Name containing `../` or an absolute path, plus attacker-controlled SBOM/documentation archive contents, yields CWE-22 arbitrary file write as the inspecting user. CVE-2026-40090 is PUBLISHED (not withdrawn/rejected); affected `>= 0.23.0, < 0.74.2`.
flaw_origin: PR #1095 first added SBOM export to a caller-supplied directory without using Metadata.Name (member ba92ddfa: OutputSBOMFiles copied tmp.Sboms straight into outputDir). Later layout/CLI refactors (GetSBOM join inside 117433c33; CLI join `filepath.Join(o.outputDir, pkgLayout.Pkg.Metadata.Name)` in b31c0bd31) and documentation inspect (74ed1e76d) only moved or cloned that same unsanitized join.
